description: qou-cds1: CORRECTS Step 21. That step concluded no phase can hide in the jet tower because every tower TRACE is real at real q; but the ladder needs an elliptic GENERATOR (complex-conjugate spectrum), and a real trace says nothing about a real spectrum. Following the owner's framing -- look for the thing that DOES the decay, and for the trefoil -- both are already in the corpus: the H_3 normal-form basis is [1,T0,T1,T0T1,T1T0,T0T1T0] whose sixth element is named 'e^-', the electron, which IS the trefoil; and qbeta_hoefsmit_tbeta_matrix_build already builds T_beta operator-valued per block. Measured in the (2,1) block at the proton pin: Delta_L = NF(n)-NF(p), the LONG model production runs on, is ELLIPTIC (tr^2-4det = -0.035837, det(traceless) = +0.008959, eigenvalues -0.045681 +- 0.094653 i), while Delta_S, the short model the ladder's closed forms come from, is HYPERBOLIC (+0.043706). Step 18's exclusions never touched Delta_L: it is an algebra element not a braid-group element, it lives in the block chi^(2,1)(Delta_S)=0 hides, and its trace is real. BUT its eigenphase is 2.020445 rad against a required 0.056595 -- a factor 35.7 -- so it is not THE ladder phase. What it retires is 'branch 3 is out of named candidates'. A coincidence is flagged and not pursued: theta sits 0.012 % from |c_3(muon)| at the SUPERSEDED CODATA-2018 anchor, with no mechanism and a documented precedent for the trap. Lean: QOU/QBeta/TraceRealSpectrumComplex.lean, sorry-free.

assertions.name: electron_word_is_the_longest_element_is_the_trefoil
assertions.detail: the H_3 NF basis is [1, T0, T1, T0T1, T1T0, T0T1T0] and its sixth element is named 'e^-' — the electron IS the trefoil, already in the corpus's own basis

assertions.name: delta_S_the_ladders_model_is_hyperbolic
assertions.detail: tr^2 - 4det = 0.043706209 > 0 — real spectrum. The two Delta models differ in KIND, not merely in value

assertions.name: step21_conclusion_over_reached
assertions.detail: Delta_L's trace is real (-0.091362974) while its spectrum is complex — so 'every tower trace is real' could never have settled whether a tower operator is elliptic. Step 21's conclusion is corrected

assertions.name: elliptic_phase_is_not_the_ladder_phase
assertions.detail: theta = 2.02044502 rad against the required 0.05659473754 — a factor 35.7002. Delta_L supplies an elliptic generator, not THE phase

assertions.name: branch3_is_not_out_of_named_candidates_after_all
assertions.detail: Step 20/21's 'out of named candidates' is withdrawn: the corpus contains an elliptic operator, in the block the short model makes invisible, and it is not in the braid image so the eigenphase exclusion never covered it

parameters.anti_fit: the theta-vs-c_3 proximity is REPORTED, not pursued; no search over combinations was run, and the anchor it matches is the superseded CODATA-2018 one

flagged_coincidence.status: FLAGGED, NOT PURSUED — no mechanism; superseded anchor

context.axis: qou-cds1: is there an elliptic operator in the tower?
context.answer: Yes — Delta_L, the long-model decay operator production runs on, is elliptic in the (2,1) block. Step 21 missed it by examining traces, which cannot see a spectrum. Its eigenphase 2.020445 is a factor 35.7 from the required 0.056595, so it is not the ladder phase.
context.corrects: Step 21's 'no phase can hide in the jet tower' and Step 20/21's 'branch 3 is out of named candidates'. The vanishing Step 21 proved -- bar-odd operators have zero Plancherel trace -- STANDS and is unaffected; what is withdrawn is the inference from trace-realness to spectrum-realness.
